card.name: Verbs after have, before a count or history
card.fires_on: Words right after a form of "have" or "were" that begin a statement about past experience or what has happened, such as a space before a number, or a past participle like been, shared, done.

modes.label: Past participle after have
modes.description: A verb or participle following have/has that reports what has been done or happened.
modes.example: even more children have<< been>> left behind than ever before in history,

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: A blank gap after "have run" just before a number of past events.
modes.example: have a good base of ten miles and have run<< >>3 half marathons, everyone tells

modes.label: Past state after were
modes.description: A word after "were" describing how something used to be.
modes.example: your periods were<< regular>> then became irregular Some girls may notice

card.writes: Weakly pushes odd code-like and foreign tokens and pushes down frequency words like weekly and daily, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the word after "have" or "were" when the text describes what someone has done or experienced before.
